quests.instruction: What item do we wear on our feet at the beach in summer?
quests.question: Sandals
quests.hint: Your toes can peek out of these!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Sandals have open straps that let your feet stay cool in the sun!
quests.funFact: Sandals let your toes feel fresh air on a hot day!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear on our hands when it is extra freezing outside?
quests.question: Mittens
quests.hint: Your fingers snuggle together inside, not separated!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Mittens keep your fingers snuggled together, which makes them extra warm!
quests.funFact: Mittens keep your fingers extra warm because they snuggle together!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear with a soft hood we can pull up over our head?
quests.question: Hoodie
quests.hint: It has a hood attached at the neck!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Hoodie has a warm hood attached that you can pull up over your head!
quests.funFact: A hoodie has its own built-in hood you can pull up any time!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear around our collar for a fancy, formal outfit?
quests.question: Tie
quests.hint: It hangs down the front of a shirt!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Tie is knotted at the collar to make an outfit look fancy and formal!
quests.funFact: A tie is knotted around the collar and hangs down a dress shirt!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear on our head with a curved brim in the front?
quests.question: Cap
quests.hint: It has a curved brim just at the front!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Cap has a curved front brim that shades your eyes from the sun!
quests.funFact: A cap has a curved brim only at the front, not all the way around!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear on our legs, stretchy and snug from waist to ankle?
quests.question: Leggings
quests.hint: They are stretchy and hug your legs closely!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Leggings are soft and stretchy, moving easily with your legs when you play!
quests.funFact: Leggings are so stretchy that they move easily with you!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear around our waist to hold our pants up?
quests.question: Belt
quests.hint: It goes around your waist!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Belt goes around your waist to keep your pants from slipping down!
quests.funFact: A belt threads through little loops to keep your pants from slipping!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear to go swimming in a pool or at the beach?
quests.question: Swimsuit
quests.hint: You wear this to go swimming!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Swimsuit is made to get wet and dry quickly for swimming!
quests.funFact: Swimsuits are made from special fabric that dries quickly after a swim!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear over our clothes when the rain starts to fall?
quests.question: Raincoat
quests.hint: It keeps rain from soaking your clothes!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Raincoat keeps rain from soaking your clothes on a wet, drizzly day!
quests.funFact: Raincoats are made from special material that water cannot soak through!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear over our eyes on a bright, sunny day?
quests.question: Sunglasses
quests.hint: They protect your eyes from bright light!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Sunglasses shade your eyes so bright sunlight does not hurt them!
quests.funFact: Sunglasses protect your eyes from strong, bright sunlight!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear over a shirt, but with no sleeves at all?
quests.question: Vest
quests.hint: It has no sleeves at all!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Vest covers your chest with no sleeves, so your arms stay free!
quests.funFact: A vest has no sleeves, so your arms stay completely free!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear on our feet when we relax at home?
quests.question: Slippers
quests.hint: They are soft and worn indoors, not outside!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Slippers are soft and easy to slide on, perfect for relaxing at home!
quests.funFact: Slippers are made soft and cozy just for wearing around the house!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear when we run, jump, and play sports?
quests.question: Sneakers
quests.hint: They are made for running and jumping!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Sneakers have bouncy soles that make running and jumping comfortable!
quests.funFact: Sneakers have soft, bouncy soles that make running more comfortable!

quests.instruction: Can you name the item we wear that can be short or reach down to our ankles?
quests.question: Skirt
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It hangs down from your waist!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Skirt hangs down from your waist and can swish as you walk!
quests.funFact: A skirt hangs down from the waist and can swish as you walk!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear closest to our skin, under all our other clothes?
quests.question: Underwear
quests.hint: It is worn first, under everything else!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Underwear is worn closest to your skin, under all your other clothes!
quests.funFact: Underwear is the very first thing you put on when you get dressed!

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear that keeps all four fingers together in one warm space?
quests.question: Mittens
quests.hint: Only your thumb gets its own little space.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Mittens keep your fingers snuggled together, which makes them extra warm!
quests.funFact: Only your thumb gets its own separate space in a mitten.

quests.instruction: Can you name the item we wear first, before we put a jacket on over it?
quests.question: Shirt
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It covers your chest, tummy, and back!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Shirt covers your chest and back to keep your top half comfy!
quests.funFact: Shirts have been worn by people for thousands of years!

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear with open straps that let our toes feel the breeze?
quests.question: Sandals
quests.hint: They have straps instead of covering your whole foot.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Sandals have open straps that let your feet stay cool in the sun!
quests.funFact: Some sandals are made specially for walking in shallow water.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear that has a cozy pocket in the front for our hands?
quests.question: Hoodie
quests.hint: It usually has a big front pocket.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Hoodie has a warm hood attached that you can pull up over your head!
quests.funFact: Many hoodies have a warm front pocket, perfect for cold hands.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear that hangs down the front of a dress shirt?
quests.question: Tie
quests.hint: It is knotted around your collar.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Tie is knotted at the collar to make an outfit look fancy and formal!
quests.funFact: Ties come in every color, pattern, and even shape you can imagine.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear that a baseball player often wears during a game?
quests.question: Cap
quests.hint: Baseball players often wear these.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Cap has a curved front brim that shades your eyes from the sun!
quests.funFact: Many sports teams have their own special caps with a logo.

quests.instruction: Can you name the item we wear that has pockets for keeping small things safe?
quests.question: Pants
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They cover both of your legs, all the way down!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Pants cover both your legs to keep them warm and safe!
quests.funFact: Pants usually have two pockets, but some have four or more!

quests.instruction: Can you name the item we wear with our coat on the coldest days of the year?
quests.question: Scarf
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It wraps around your neck!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Scarf wraps around your neck to keep it warm and cozy!
quests.funFact: Scarves keep our necks warm when it snows!

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear under a dress or skirt for extra warmth?
quests.question: Leggings
quests.hint: They are thinner and more flexible than jeans.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Leggings are soft and stretchy, moving easily with your legs when you play!
quests.funFact: Leggings can be worn alone or underneath a skirt or dress.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear that gets wet and dries quickly after a swim?
quests.question: Swimsuit
quests.hint: It is made to get wet and dry fast.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Swimsuit is made to get wet and dry quickly for swimming!
quests.funFact: The very first swimsuits were made of wool, which got very heavy when wet.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear through the little loops on the top of our pants?
quests.question: Belt
quests.hint: It threads through little loops on your pants.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Belt goes around your waist to keep your pants from slipping down!
quests.funFact: Belts can be made of leather, cloth, or even stretchy elastic.

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear on our hands when it is cold outside?
quests.question: Gloves
quests.hint: Think about this: Each finger gets its very own little space.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Gloves keep every finger warm and toasty in cold weather!
quests.funFact: Gloves give our fingers a warm hug in winter!

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear to keep the strong sunlight from hurting our eyes?
quests.question: Sunglasses
quests.hint: They have two dark lenses.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Sunglasses shade your eyes so bright sunlight does not hurt them!
quests.funFact: Good sunglasses also help block harmful rays from the sun.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear instead of shoes, right after we wake up in the morning?
quests.question: Slippers
quests.hint: You slide these on easily, with no laces.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Slippers are soft and easy to slide on, perfect for relaxing at home!
quests.funFact: You can slide slippers on and off in just a second, with no laces.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear that keeps every drop of rain off our clothes?
quests.question: Raincoat
quests.hint: It often has a hood.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Raincoat keeps rain from soaking your clothes on a wet, drizzly day!
quests.funFact: Many raincoats have a hood attached to keep your hair dry too.
